params.body: Crust color, a little lighter or darker per plate (Voronoi's Random), rusted in patches by an oxide tint, reddened by the rim, and nearly black inside the seam where only the glow shows.
params.title: Crust

params.body: A fine Voronoi 3D of the drifting crust; its Random lights one cell in ten. F1 draws a soft round speck around each lit point, and Derivatives widens its edge by one pixel (Fwidth) so small specks never alias. Only those along a seam show, flickering with Time.
params.title: Embers

params.body: The object position × plate scale, slid by Time × flow speed so the crust drifts, then bent by a slow noise so the plates never look like straight cells.
params.title: Drifting crust

params.body: The heat picks a temperature between a dull 850 K and Temperature; Blackbody turns it into the color of glowing rock. Heat² × glow intensity makes it HDR, well past 1, so the tone mapping rolls the hottest seams off into yellow-white.
params.title: Blackbody glow

params.body: A sine of Time plus a noise phase sends pulses of heat along the seams. The seam carries the pulse; the rim keeps a third of it. The hotter of the two is the heat, 0 to 1.
params.title: Travelling heat

params.body: Voronoi 3D splits the crust into plates; Edge is small along their borders. Crack width × crust coverage sets how wide the molten seam is; three times that is the hot rim the seam bakes into the crust.
params.title: Plates and seams

params.body: The seams sink: the position moves in along the mesh's own (object) normal by the seam × depth. A fine noise gives the crust its grain through Normal From Height; Derivatives measures how much that noise changes per pixel and fades it out before it shimmers.
params.title: Relief

params.body: Rough, matte crust; a satin melt under a thin, soft clear coat, its Specular Intensity turned down so the glow, not a reflection, lights the seam; Ambient Occlusion darkens the crust along the rim, where it folds down into the seam.
params.title: Gloss, coat and occlusion
